required: Current phase/revision and authorized reviewer lineage
Sealed Phase 6 report and automatic advancement authorization
Accepted Phase-6 successor handoff receipt bound to reviewer-4
Latest controller-accepted Source Intelligence Bundle Index revision/commit/digest and component accepted identities bound to the exact current source/build identity
conditional: Triggered domain ledgers/resources explicitly referenced by active steps
Live deployment/release/fork/remediation artifacts only when the phase card trigger applies

steps.action: Open the P6_TO_P7 successor bootstrap and verify the handoff
steps.instruction: Use the GitHub connector app inside the exact campaign workspace. Exhaust the handoff recovery ladder before any blocker message.

Use the GitHub connector app only for all controller/Contract-Automation repository access. Prove supported Ethereum archive-fork identity, Anvil launch/hardfork, target code, impersonation and workflow readiness.

steps.action: Revalidate domain applicability for lifecycle execution
steps.instruction: Consume the exact current Domain Applicability Registry. Reevaluate any decision affected by new Phase-4/5/6 evidence. For every TRIGGERED/UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE domain with an expressible lifecycle property/hypothesis, map it to a simulation recipe, explicit non-expressible disposition, or typed blocker/limitation.
Map target integrations, domain obligations and security properties to standardized lifecycle recipes; record RECIPE_GAP for a required expressible scenario that lacks one.
Preserve exact chain/block/profile, configuration, actors, initial state, action sequence and evidence identity.
Test state transitions, repeated cycles, boundaries and integration behavior against implementation properties and activated domain obligations.

If DOMAIN-OFFCHAIN is TRIGGERED/UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE and lifecycle-expressible, test keeper/bot/off-chain critical workflows and failure/recovery behavior; otherwise preserve the required typed disposition.
If DOMAIN-CROSSCHAIN is TRIGGERED/UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE and supported/expressible, execute deterministic scenarios; otherwise preserve the required typed limitation/RECIPE_GAP.

steps.action: Verify deployment ceremony and accept gas evidence
steps.instruction: Compare preliminary core estimates to the exact accepted Phase-7 build/lifecycle identity. Record gas for every independently deployable production contract, reject stale identities under EIM-016, and update the runtime overlay gas-acceptance section.

Validate the accepted overlay revision against current deployed code/configuration/release identity and evidence; otherwise record typed NOT_APPLICABLE. Any change follows EIM-014, not silent path replacement.

steps.action: Accept the runtime-overlay revision and complete the lifecycle ledger
steps.instruction: Create one stable SIM-* record per required/executed scenario, validate/commit the runtime overlay, update/commit the bundle index with accepted revision/commit/digest/status/invalidation state, preserve the prior snapshot, and complete coverage reconciliation.

Update graph/domain/obligation state; verify every Phase-7 domain obligation is terminal or properly carried with typed evidence; freeze current digests. Classify every material observed change under the Evidence Invalidation Matrix before reusing affected evidence.

steps.action: File the phase report and auto-advance
steps.instruction: Seal the required structured artifact/global checkpoints, file the immutable Phase Report, enter AUTO_ADVANCE_READY, and immediately continue into the next same-reviewer phase under the Automatic Phase Advancement Protocol. Do not wait for human approval.

phaseRequirement: Add SIM-* nodes; map lifecycle/integration simulations to PROP-*/HYP-*/CAND-* targets and results.

sealingCriteria: All mandatory phase-card steps completed or have a permitted typed terminal limitation/failure disposition.
Phase-specific structured filing is complete, exact-source-bound, durable, and digest-referenced.

Source Intelligence Bundle checkpoint records the accepted index and core/runtime component revision/commit/digest. Phase-7 lifecycle, runtime/configuration, and gas evidence are validated into a committed runtime-overlay revision; preliminary Phase-1 gas or current mutable-path bytes cannot satisfy acceptance.
Security Traceability Graph is updated for this phase and its current campaign-local digest/reference is recorded.
All obligations due in this phase are reconciled in the canonical obligation ledger; no due OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation remains.
Every new later-phase obligation has a stable OBL-* ID and objective completion condition.
Phase Report references phase-specific artifact, traceability graph checkpoint, obligation ledger checkpoint, evidence, limitations, and invalidation triggers.
Required process failures have exhausted repair/retry/recovery or are repaired and verified; silent omission is forbidden.
Domain Applicability Registry is current for the exact source; every TRIGGERED/UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE domain obligation due in this phase is executed or has an explicit typed terminal disposition.
Every material observed change event is classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX; INVALIDATES/REQUIRES_REBIND work is replaced, reconciled, or carried as a typed OBL-* before sealing.
